title: Revenue Leakage Detection: 5-Step Process to Find Hidden Losses
description: How to detect revenue leakage with benchmarks, funnel mapping, and dollar estimates — without a full analytics stack.

faq.q: How do you detect revenue leakage?
faq.a: Map your funnel end to end, measure conversion at each step, compare to benchmarks, estimate monthly dollar impact, and fix the highest-impact stage first.
Stripe, your CRM, and analytics cover most gaps. Structure matters more than tooling — a diagnostic questionnaire can surface leaks in minutes.

blocks.text: Revenue leakage detection is not about more dashboards. It is about asking: where does the funnel drop below benchmark, and what does that gap cost per month?

items: Draw the journey from stranger to repeat buyer — one owner per stage
Attach a metric to each transition (even rough ranges)
Color-code stages red/yellow/green vs niche benchmarks
Multiply lost conversions by average revenue per customer
Rank leaks by impact and effort; assign one owner per fix

blocks.text: For profit-focused framing, see [how to identify profit leaks](/blog/identify-profit-leaks). For billing-specific leaks, see [failed payment recovery](/blog/failed-payment-recovery).

items: Traffic or leads up, revenue flat
Impressions up in search, clicks flat (intent mismatch)

blocks.headline: Run automated leakage detection in 5 minutes
